mapper.select: SELECT CODE AS "code", CODE_NM AS "name", ADD_VAL1 AS "addVal1", ADD_VAL2 AS "addVal2", ADD_VAL3 AS "addVal3", trim_scale(CODE_VAL)::text AS "codeVal", UNIT_NM AS "unitNm" FROM TB_SY_CODE WHERE CODE_GRP_ID=#{group} AND DEL_YN='N' AND USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORD,CODE

SELECT STD_CD AS "key", CASE WHEN STD_CD='CASH_BASE_YM' THEN lpad(trunc(STD_VAL)::text,6,'0') ELSE trim_scale(STD_VAL)::text END AS "value", UNIT_NM AS "unitNm", substring(APLY_BGN_YM,1,4)||'-'||substring(APLY_BGN_YM,5,2) AS "effectiveMonth" FROM TB_SY_OPER_STD WHERE STD_CD=#{key} AND APLY_BGN_YM <= #{month} ORDER BY APLY_BGN_YM DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT lpad(trunc(STD_VAL)::text,6,'0') FROM TB_SY_OPER_STD WHERE STD_CD='CASH_BASE_YM' ORDER BY APLY_BGN_YM DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CLOSE_YM AS "month", CLOSE_STAT_CD AS "status" FROM TB_CL_CLOSE WHERE CLOSE_YM >= #{from} AND CLOSE_YM <= #{to} ORDER BY CLOSE_YM

SELECT MENU_ID AS "menuId", UPPER_MENU_ID AS "parentId", MENU_NM AS "name", SCRN_ID AS "screenId", MENU_LVL AS "level", SORT_ORD AS "sortOrder", USE_YN AS "useYn", ICON_NM AS "icon", PC_ONLY_YN='Y' AS "pcOnly" FROM TB_SY_MENU ORDER BY SORT_ORD,MENU_ID
mapper.sql: SELECT h.HIST_ID AS "histId", h.REG_DTTM AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS "occurredAt", CASE h.TRGT_TBL_NM WHEN 'TB_SY_CODE_GRP' THEN 'GROUP' WHEN 'TB_SY_CODE' THEN CASE WHEN g.VAL_CODE_YN='Y' THEN 'VALUE_CODE' ELSE 'CODE' END WHEN 'TB_SY_OPER_STD' THEN 'OPER_STD' WHEN 'TB_SY_CODE_MAP' THEN 'CODE_MAP' END AS "target", CASE WHEN h.TRGT_TBL_NM='TB_SY_CODE_GRP' THEN h.TRGT_KEY WHEN h.TRGT_TBL_NM IN ('TB_SY_CODE','TB_SY_CODE_MAP') THEN split_part(h.TRGT_KEY,':',1) END AS "groupId", h.TRGT_KEY AS "entityKey", h.CHG_TYPE_CD AS "type", h.CHG_ITEM_NM AS "item", h.BFR_VAL AS "before", h.AFT_VAL AS "after", h.REG_USER_ID AS "actor" FROM TB_SY_CHG_HIST h LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE_GRP g ON h.TRGT_TBL_NM='TB_SY_CODE' AND g.CODE_GRP_ID=split_part(h.TRGT_KEY,':',1) WHERE h.TRGT_TBL_NM IN ('TB_SY_CODE_GRP','TB_SY_CODE','TB_SY_OPER_STD','TB_SY_CODE_MAP')
mapper.select: SELECT q.* FROM () q ORDER BY q."occurredAt" DESC,q."histId" DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
